summary: Enhance your NGO's impact with practical communication strategies, frameworks, and digital tools. Enroll to master stakeholder engagement and crisis response.
lede: NGO communication involves shaping clear messages for donors, communities, media and other stakeholders. This course is for non-profit professionals who plan communications and stakeholder engagement, helping them develop practical approaches for reaching audiences and supporting organizational goals. Learners explore impact storytelling, stakeholder mapping, crisis response planning and ways to assess campaign engagement using metrics and dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals in the non-profit sector who handle communication and stakeholder engagement in high-impact environments.
audience: Digital Content Creators for Humanitarian Organizations
prerequisites: No specific prerequisites are required, but participants should have basic experience in NGO operations or communication roles. Familiarity with social media platforms and basic digital tools will enhance your learning experience.
